import os, stat, json, subprocess, sys
root="/app/submission"

        print("%s mode=%s nlink=%d size=%d" % (p, stat.filemode(st.st_mode), st.st_nlink, st.st_size))

got=json.loads(p.stdout.decode().strip()); exp=json.loads(open('/app/examples/response.jsonl').read().strip())
print("public example matches reference exactly:", got==exp)
PYEOF
